name: Amlodipine (Norvasc)
critical_contraindications: St. John's Wort (Loss of therapeutic effect)
timing_rule: Morning or bedtime consistently. Avoid high-dose potassium without monitoring.

name: Metoprolol (Lopressor / Toprol-XL)
timing_rule: Take with or immediately following meals. Do not abruptly discontinue.

name: Ramipril / Lisinopril
timing_rule: Bedtime or morning. Avoid co-administering with acute high-dose potassium.

name: Atorvastatin (Lipitor) / Rosuvastatin (Crestor)
timing_rule: Bedtime. Mandatory co-administration with CoQ10 (Ubiquinol 100-200mg) to prevent statin-induced myopathy.

name: Warfarin (Coumadin) / Apixaban (Eliquis)
category: Anticoagulant (Vitamin K Antagonist / Factor Xa Inhibitor)
timing_rule: Fixed evening timing. Never consume variable amounts of Vitamin K without INR tracking.

name: Metformin HCl (Glucophage)
critical_contraindications: Berberine (Additive Complex-I inhibition risks lactic acidosis)
timing_rule: With evening meal. Must supplement Methylated B12 (Metformin blocks intestinal B12 absorption).

name: Semaglutide / Tirzepatide (Ozempic / Wegovy / Mounjaro)
category: GLP-1 / GIP Dual Incretin Receptor Agonist
critical_contraindications: Oral extended-release capsules (Delayed gastric transit risks erratic dissolution)
timing_rule: SubQ once weekly. Separate oral morning pills with 400ml water to ensure transit through delayed pylorus.

name: Levothyroxine (Euthyrox / Synthroid)
timing_rule: Strictly fasted upon waking with water. Zero food, coffee, or other supplements for 60 minutes.

name: Omeprazole / Pantoprazole / Esomeprazole
primary_indication: GERD / Peptic Ulcer Disease / Barrett's Esophagus
timing_rule: 30-60 minutes before breakfast. Must switch to chelated Magnesium Bisglycinate and Calcium Citrate.

name: Sertraline (Zoloft) / Escitalopram (Lexapro)
timing_rule: Morning with breakfast (prevents nocturnal insomnia).

name: Bupropion (Wellbutrin XL)
timing_rule: Early morning upon waking. Avoid taking past 12:00 PM to protect sleep architecture.

name: Methylphenidate (Ritalin / Concerta) / Adderall
timing_rule: Morning with protein-rich breakfast. Take Vitamin C at night to acidify urine and clear residual amphetamines.

name: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound)
primary_indication: Tendon, Ligament, Muscle and Gut Mucosal Repair
critical_contraindications: Active systemic malignancy (Theoretically upregulates VEGF angiogenesis)
timing_rule: Fasted 250-500mcg. Oral arginate for intestine; Subcutaneous for joint/tendon.

name: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment)
primary_indication: Systemic Tissue Regeneration / Flexibility / Cardiac Tissue Repair
timing_rule: SubQ 2.5mg - 5mg twice weekly during repair phase.

name: Epithalon (Epithalamin Tetra-peptide)
critical_contraindications: Continuous uncycled usage (Must cycle 10-20 days twice annually)
timing_rule: Morning or early afternoon SubQ 5mg-10mg for 10-day cycles.

name: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin
category: GHRH Analog + Selective Ghrelin Receptor Agonist
primary_indication: Growth Hormone Secretion / Deep Sleep / Lean Mass
critical_contraindications: Post-prandial intake (Elevated blood glucose completely blunts GH pulse)
timing_rule: Strictly 2-3 hours after last meal, immediately prior to bedtime.

name: NMN / NR (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide / Riboside)
primary_indication: SIRT1/SIRT3 Activation / DNA Repair / Mitochondrial ATP
critical_contraindications: Taking without Methyl donors (TMG/Betaine) in MTHFR slow metabolizers
timing_rule: Fasted upon waking (07:00 - 08:30) synchronized with peak NAMPT gene expression.

name: Berberine Phytosome (Dihydroberberine)
primary_indication: Post-prandial Glucose Blunting / Lipid Profile / Longevity
timing_rule: 15-20 minutes prior to the largest carbohydrate-containing meal.

name: Magnesium L-Threonate (Magtein)
primary_indication: Synaptic Density / Neuroplasticity / Deep Stage 4 Sleep
critical_contraindications: Simultaneous Calcium intake (Competes for DMT1 carrier)
timing_rule: 1-2 capsules in afternoon, 1 capsule 45 minutes before sleep.

name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol) + K2 (MK-7)
primary_indication: Immune Cell Modulation / Bone Density / Cardiovascular Health
timing_rule: Midday with a meal containing at least 15g healthy fats (avocado, eggs, olive oil).
